title: U.S. passport validity - basics
facts: A regular U.S. passport issued to an applicant age 16 or older is generally valid for 10 years.
A regular U.S. passport issued to a child under age 16 is generally valid for 5 years.
Some destination countries require a passport to remain valid for a specified period beyond the planned travel dates, so an unexpired passport is not always sufficient for entry.
Passport validity and destination entry requirements are separate issues.
